patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: (Mom) She's got a runny nose and a little cough for a couple days, low-grade temp, but she's eating, drinking, and running around like normal. My daycare said to get her checked.
clinical.presentationShort: 5yo F — mild URI, well-appearing, playful, hydrated, no distress, normal exam — viral cold.
clinical.presentationLong: 5-year-old female with a mild cold, well-appearing and playful, well-hydrated with no respiratory distress and a normal exam — viral URI.

diagnosis.esi2roomsNotes: ESI 5: no ED treatment-area resources are expected; brief evaluation, counseling, and discharge are appropriate.
diagnosis.disposition: Discharge → supportive care, hydration, return precautions; no antibiotics. Reassurance.
diagnosis.why: Playful, feeding, hydrated, normal exam = well child with a cold. Reassure and discharge — a fast, easy call.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: wiggly on the chair, a tissue in hand
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a black 5-year-old girl, bright and playful, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: wiggly and energetic, a tissue in one hand. Expression: cheerful despite a runny nose. Clearly visible: a lively, well child holding a tissue. No text, no logos.
